STH — Core & Aggregation
STH-32QC-HSI
32×400G QSFP112 data center switch — 25.6Tbps, full MPLS/VXLAN/EVPN stack, MACsec encryption, dual hot-swap 1300W PSU and 6× smart fan modules.
Key Differentiators
32×400G — 25.6Tbps for AI/ML clusters and HPC, scalable to 64×400G
32× QSFP112 400G ports deliver 25.6Tbps bidirectional switching at 38.09Gpps L2/L3 throughput. Expandable to 64×400G models for mega-scale topologies without re-architecture. Compact 1U form factor maximizes rack density in hyperscale deployments.
Full MPLS / VXLAN / EVPN / BGP — enterprise and carrier overlay in one box
Complete MPLS suite (LDP, L2VPN/VPWS/VPLS, L3VPN) plus VXLAN distributed gateway and EVPN/BGP for multi-tenant cloud DC overlays and cross-datacenter interconnect. MACsec (802.1AE) encryption and PFC/ECN/DCBX for lossless Ethernet in storage and HPC networks.
Dual 1300W hot-swap PSU + 6× smart fan modules — zero downtime maintenance
Two CRPS hot-swappable power supplies maintain full-load traffic during in-service replacement. Six intelligently-controlled fan modules with front-to-back airflow adapt thermal management at 25.6Tbps. MTBF ≥90,000 hours with hardware watchdog and auto-recovery.
Application
AI Training Clusters

Cloud Data Centers
Multi-DC Overlay
Telecom Metro Backhaul
Any hyperscale or carrier deployment requiring 400G density, enterprise overlay protocols, and in-service hardware maintenance without traffic interruption.

STC — Commercial Ethernet
STC-448XGGMO
48-port all-fiber Layer 3 managed switch — 13K dynamic routing entries, dual AC redundant power, USB and Console management in 1U rack form factor.
Key Differentiators
Full L3 dynamic routing with 13K entries — OSPF, BGP4, RIP, IS-IS
Hardware-accelerated IPv4/IPv6 static and dynamic routing with ECMP load balancing. Supports OSPF, BGP4, RIP, IS-IS for complex topologies and automatic failover. VRRP for virtual router redundancy. 336Gbps switching capacity at 499.9Mpps — scales from branch to campus backhaul.
All-fiber port architecture — 48× SFP + 4× 10G SFP+, zero copper
48× 100/1000M SFP downlinks with 4× multi-rate 10G SFP+ uplinks — full optical fabric eliminates EMI/EMC noise. Hot-swappable transceivers support mixed single-mode, multi-mode, and rates on demand. Purpose-built for electrically harsh environments and outdoor fiber runs.
Dual AC redundant power + USB + Console — local and remote management
Two independent 100–240V AC inputs switch seamlessly on mains loss. Console (RJ45) and USB 2.0 ports enable local firmware upgrade and emergency recovery. Dual-partition firmware supports in-service OS upgrade without downtime.
Application
Telecom Backbone
Dark Fiber WAN
Campus Core
Industrial Backhaul
Carrier Aggregation
Any noise-sensitive or EMI-critical deployment requiring full L3 routing, all-fiber port density, and carrier-grade power redundancy in a 1U rack chassis.

STC — Commercial Ethernet
STC-448XGGPM-4BT-740W
48-port Gigabit L2+ managed PoE++ switch — 4 ports at 90W (IEEE 802.3bt), 740W total budget, 4× 10G SFP+ uplinks, optional dual AC redundant power.
Key Differentiators
4-port 90W PoE++ (BT) — PTZ cameras and Wi-Fi 6E APs without injectors
Ports 1–4 deliver up to 90W per port (IEEE 802.3bt) for high-draw devices — PTZ cameras, Wi-Fi 6/6E APs, video conferencing terminals. Remaining 44 ports support standard PoE/PoE+ up to 30W. 740W total budget covers full-density deployment without external power injectors.
4× multi-rate 10G SFP+ uplinks with ERPS ring protection
Each SFP+ slot runs 1G/2.5G/10G — aggregates 48 downstream Gigabit PoE ports at 336Gbps switching capacity with sub-5µs forwarding delay. G.8032 ERPS delivers ≤20ms failover across redundant fiber ring topologies.
Dual AC redundant power — optional for zero-downtime deployments
Two independent 100–240V AC inputs switch seamlessly on mains loss. Per-port PoE watchdog, power scheduling, and dual-partition firmware ensure automatic recovery in unmanned network closets and data center access layers.
Application

Data Center Access
Education & Healthcare
Any high-port-count PoE++ deployment requiring 90W per-port capability, 10G fiber uplinks, and optional power supply redundancy in a 1U rack form factor.

STI — Industrial Networking
STI-4240XGGM
24-port Gigabit L3 industrial switch with DI/DO/RS485 I/O, integrated temperature-humidity sensor, and 4× 10G SFP+ uplinks.
Key Differentiators
Integrated temperature-humidity monitoring — no external sensor needed
Built-in RS485 temperature-humidity sensor provides real-time environmental data directly through the switch management interface. Eliminates the need for a separate sensor gateway — ideal for unmanned substations, outdoor cabinets, and SCADA-connected field sites.
Full L3 routing with DI/DO/RS485 in a DIN-rail form factor
Hardware-accelerated IPv4/IPv6 static routing, OSPF, and RIP on 24 GE ports — with native DI/DO (12–30V input, 2A@30VDC output) and RS485 Modbus RTU over TCP/IP. One device replaces a switch, serial gateway, and sensor node.
4× multi-rate 10G SFP+ uplinks with ERPS ring protection
Each SFP+ slot runs 1G/2.5G/10G — same hardware connects to existing 1G aggregation or upgrades to 10G backbone without device replacement. G.8032 ERPS delivers ≤20ms ring failover for continuous uptime in critical infrastructure.

STI — Industrial Networking
STI-288DGGPM
8-port PoE+ industrial switch with native DI/DO/RS485 I/O and dual 1G/2.5G SFP uplinks — 240W total PoE budget.
Key Differentiators
Native DI/DO/RS485 — no external serial gateway needed
Removable 8-pin terminal block integrates digital input (12–30V), digital output (relay/pulse, 2A@30VDC), and RS485 Modbus RTU over TCP/IP. Connect PLCs, RTUs, meters, and field sensors directly to your IP network — one device, not two.
Dual 1G/2.5G SFP uplinks with ≤20ms ERPS ring failover
Multi-rate SFP slots run 1GBase-X or 2.5GBase-X on the same hardware — adapts to existing 1G infrastructure and 2.5G backbone upgrades without device replacement. G.8032 ERPS ring protection recovers in ≤20ms.
8× PoE+ with per-port watchdog and power scheduling
All 8 RJ45 ports deliver up to 30W (IEEE 802.3af/at), 240W total. Per-port PD watchdog, power priority, and scheduling enable unattended fault recovery in unmanned deployments.
Application
IP Surveillance

Utility Substations
